newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron keeps lead in Philippine oil market.
newsitem.headline: Petron keeps lead in Philippine oil market.

text.p: Oil refiner Petron Corp maintained the biggest share of the Philippine oil market at 41.3 percent for the first 11 months of the year from 41 percent in the same period last year, industry data showed.
Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp posted the biggest increase in market share to 33.8 percent from 31.9 percent in the 11 month period, the data made available to Reuters on Friday showed.

The total oil inland trade data, a montly document put together by the country's three oil refiners, said market share of Caltex Philippines Inc dropped to 24.8 percent in the first 11 months this year from 27.1 percent in the same 1995 period.
Pilipinas Shell is a unit of the Royal Dutch/Shell Group while Caltex Philippines is a unit of Caltex Petroleum.
Petron is 40 percent owned by Saudi Arabia's Aramco.

The data showed Pilipinas Shell had the biggest chunk of the petrol and liquefied petroleum products market while Petron had the lead in the diesel and jet fuel market. Caltex dominated the market for kerosene, it said.
Total oil inland trade from January to November this year rose by 5.54 percent to 118.251 million barrels from 112.04 million barrels.
